card.name: Linking words before mineral and metal names
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "of", "to", "on" or the verb "accumulate" right before a mineral or metal such as copper, calcium, aluminum or iron. Seen in warnings about buildup, levels or precipitates.

modes.label: "of" after level nouns
modes.description: The word "of" after nouns like concentration, formation or levels, just before a metal or mineral term.
modes.example: or the concentration<< of>> free serum copper is persistently above

modes.label: Accumulate before aluminum
modes.description: The verb "accumulate" just before aluminum in warnings about parenteral aluminum.
modes.example: who receive parenteral levels of aluminum at greater than 4 to 5 mcg/kg/day<< accumulate>> aluminum at levels associated with central nervous system

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: "to" or "on" leading into copper or iron stores.
modes.example: Impaired copper transport in patients with Menkes disease can lead<< to>> copper accumulation and organ impairment in the kidneys

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from bicarbonate or hydrogen terms and toward other mineral or metal names.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a metal or mineral such as copper, calcium or aluminum is named.
